query: 灵活工作安排 灵活工作安排 衡量企业在远程/弹性办公方面的制度与执行。 一、 内容质量得分 (权重 50%) 衡量制度的专业性与可执行度，防止“口头承诺”而无制度保障。 2分：卓越（三要素齐全） 制度清晰： 明确定义了弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时（如 4.5 天工作制）的具体形式，针对特殊员工群体有单独的配套措施。 适用边界： 清楚界定了哪些岗位适用、申请流程及审批权限，具有极强的操作性。 绩效协同： 建立了“以结果为导向”的考核机制，确保灵活办公不影响协作效率（如配套的线上协作工具、核心协作时间规定）。 1分：合格 包含一个或两个 0分：缺失 未披露任何相关信息，或企业文化明确强调全员必须现场打卡且无弹性空间。 二、 覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%,) 衡量制度的穿透力，即多少员工真正受益。 2分：全覆盖与高穿透 覆盖率： 机制覆盖 100% 符合岗位性质的员工（如非生产一线人员全覆盖）。 执行数据： 披露了实际使用灵活办公人数占符合条件人数的比例。 满意度： 披露了针对灵活办公效果的员工满意度调研结果。 1分：合格 提及个别案例或极少数特殊岗位（如孕期员工）可申请。 0分：不满足/无数据 无法证明制度已在实际中得到应用。 灵活工作安排 弹性工时 远程办公 混合办公 居家办公 压缩工时 核心协作时间 弹性工作制度 WFH hybrid work flexible working flexible working hours remote work hybrid work work from home compressed workweek core collaboration hours flexible work arrangement WFH 企业是否定义弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时等具体形式？ 适用岗位、申请流程与审批权限是否明确？ 是否建立结果导向考核或核心协作时间等配套？ 披露了多少符合条件员工实际使用灵活办公？ 是否有相关满意度结果？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '灵活工作安排'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 企业是否定义弹性工时、远程办公或压缩工时等具体形式？ 适用岗位、申请流程与审批权限是否明确？ 是否建立结果导向考核或核心协作时间等配套？ 披露了多少符合条件员工实际使用灵活办公？ 是否有相关满意度结果？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有加班管理；仅有育儿假/产假制度；仅有居家办公临时防疫安排；仅有企业文化宣传无制度；区分：灵活工作安排关注远程/弹性办公制度与执行；反歧视政策关注禁止歧视；平等机会措施关注招聘晋升选拔公平流程，三者不可互相替代。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: Ju Teng International strictly follow the 'Labour Law of the People's Republic of China' and established internal policies and systems such as 'Working Time and Remuneration Management Procedures' and 'Personnel Administrative Systems and Related Norms', and employees are provided with reasonable and appropriate rest time during normal working hours. results.section: ABOUT JU TENG INTERNATIONAL / Company overview
results.text: Established in 2000, Ju Teng International is a casing manufacturer specialising in 3C products. Its major customers include HP, Dell, Acer and Asus and its production bases cover Eastern China, Western China and Taiwan. After 21 years of endeavours, Ju Teng International have been well recognised by our customers. In 2021, the global economy experienced a downward trend due to the continuous effect of the outbreak of the 2019 Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. However, the pandemic has increased the demand for remote working and learning. Remote working and learning have become a new trend in lifestyle and have driven the development of the personal computer market, also bringing new opportunities and challenges to the Group. Taking advantage of this market opportunity, we take the initiative to improve the level of R&D and core competitiveness, while remaining cautious in the face of risks and uncertainties, adjusting our strategies flexibly and growing steadily in the midst of challenges.

ABOUT JU TENG INTERNATIONAL / Company overview

[Content]
Established in 2000, Ju Teng International is a casing manufacturer specialising in 3C products. Its major customers include HP, Dell, Acer and Asus and its production bases cover Eastern China, Western China and Taiwan. After 21 years of endeavours, Ju Teng International have been well recognised by our customers. In 2021, the global economy experienced a downward trend due to the continuous effect of the outbreak of the 2019 Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic. However, the pandemic has increased the demand for remote working and learning. Remote working and learning have become a new trend in lifestyle and have driven the development of the personal computer market, also bringing new opportunities and challenges to the Group. Taking advantage of this market opportunity, we take the initiative to improve the level of R&D and core competitiveness, while remaining cautious in the face of risks and uncertainties, adjusting our strategies flexibly and growing steadily in the midst of challenges.

results.section: RESPONSIBILITIES OF THE MANAGEMENT / Materiality identification and communication
results.text: During the Reporting Period, Ju Teng International strictly complied with the 'Anti-Unfair Competition Law of the People's Republic of China' to protect the fair competition market and stop unfair competition practices. Meanwhile, we remain committed to managing our business practices in accordance with the 'Responsible Business Alliance (RBA) Code of Conduct', and require that the management and all employees strictly abide by it. We have established this Code as a programmatic document to achieve the Company's professional ethics, honest operation and compliance goals. Ju Teng International had not provided trainings on ethics and anti-corruption for employees during the year due to the COVID-19 pandemic. In accordance with this Code, we have formulated the internal 'Business Ethics Management Procedure' to strictly manage the business ethics of our employees. We continue to provide channels such as telephone hotlines and emails for anyone to report corruption and immorality of our employees in real names or anonymously.
